games.name: SIP Farm
games.tagline: Plant monthly seeds and harvest the power of compounding!
rules: Each round, choose your monthly SIP seed amount (₹1,000 to ₹10,000).
Weather events (good monsoon, drought, storm) represent market cycles.
Discipline bonus: Never skipping a seed round yields compounding multipliers!
games.learning_goal: Demonstrates rupee-cost averaging and how patience compounds modest savings into a large harvest.

games.name: Crash Survivor
games.tagline: A sudden -30% market dip strikes! Can your emotions survive?
rules: A sudden economic crash slashes market values by 30%.
Social media is screaming doom. You must choose: PANIC SELL, HOLD FIRM, or BUY THE DIP.
Over the next 4 turns, watch the recovery curve unfold.
Points are awarded for resisting panic and adhering to long-term horizon.
games.learning_goal: Teaches the psychology of market crashes and the steep cost of panic selling.

games.name: Scam Detective
games.tagline: Inspect 8 suspicious tips and unmask the fraudsters!
rules: You are presented with 8 incoming WhatsApp/Telegram messages and tips.
Identify whether each tip is LEGITIMATE or a SCAM.
Spot red flags like 'guaranteed returns', 'exclusive VIP channels', or 'hurry last 5 spots'.
Score 7 or 8 correct to earn master detective badge!

tips.text: SEBI-registered index fund with 0.1% expense ratio tracking NIFTY 50 over 10-year horizon.
tips.explanation: Transparent, low-cost index tracking with a registered entity and realistic long-term horizon.

tips.text: Join our secret WhatsApp VIP group! 100% guaranteed 25% weekly returns on secret crypto bot. Transfer ₹5000 to unlock.
tips.explanation: Guaranteed weekly returns do not exist. Requests for upfront fees to private chat groups are textbook scams.

tips.text: Public Provident Fund (PPF) offering 7.1% tax-free annual returns backed by the Government of India with a 15-year tenure.
tips.explanation: PPF is an official sovereign savings scheme regulated by the Ministry of Finance.

tips.text: URGENT: Hot penny stock insider tip! Tomorrow it will hit upper circuit 20%. Invest your entire salary today before 9:15 AM!
tips.explanation: Urgency, pump-and-dump penny stock touting, and claims of insider information are illegal manipulations.

tips.text: Deposit ₹10,000 in our Global Forex Fund, earn ₹1,000 every day, plus ₹2,000 bonus for every friend you recruit!
tips.explanation: Recruitment bonuses linked to unsustainable daily returns characterize a classic Ponzi / pyramid scheme.

tips.text: Diversified Flexi-cap Mutual Fund investing across large, mid, and small cap equities managed by an AMC.
tips.explanation: Standard SEBI-regulated diversified equity fund with clear mandate and regulatory oversight.

tips.text: Finfluencer DM: 'Hey buddy, I saw your profile. Send me ₹25,000 and my automated algo will double it in 48 hours with zero risk.'
tips.explanation: No algorithm can double money in 48 hours without risk. Impersonation and unsolicited DMs are fraud.

tips.text: Bank Fixed Deposit for 1 year tenure at 7.25% p.a. interest, insured under DICGC up to ₹5 lakh.
tips.explanation: Regulated scheduled commercial bank FD protected by RBI's deposit insurance.

games.learning_goal: Trains intuition to quickly filter fraudulent offers and verify SEBI/RBI legitimacy.

games.name: Budget Bazaar
games.tagline: Balance your monthly budget against unexpected life surprises!
rules: Allocate your monthly income across Needs, Wants, and Savings.
Survive 4 random weekly life events (e.g. bike repair, dental emergency, flash sale).
Keep your emergency buffer intact without taking high-interest loans.

events.title: Motorbike Breakdown
events.description: Your two-wheeler broke down on the ring road. The mechanic quotes ₹3,500 for replacement parts and towing.

choices.label: Cancel this month's dining out and pay from cash
Swipe Credit Card with revolving 42% APR

events.title: Friend's Destination Wedding
events.description: Your college roommate is getting married in Goa. Flights, stay and gifts will cost ₹8,000.

choices.label: Set a strict ₹2,500 gift budget and attend reception locally
choices.hint: Living within true means without FOMO.

choices.label: Drain Emergency Fund to party in Goa
choices.hint: Emergency fund is for survival, not vacations.

choices.label: Take an instant Buy-Now-Pay-Later (BNPL) loan
choices.hint: Borrowing for lifestyle ruins future cashflows.

events.title: Sudden Dental Root Canal
events.description: A severe toothache strikes during exams/work. Dentist says root canal treatment costs ₹4,500 immediately.

choices.label: Pay from Health Emergency Buffer
choices.hint: Health comes first, emergency cushion saves you.

choices.label: Cut shopping & entertainment to zero this month
Pay using high-cost salary advance loan
choices.hint: Predatory interest rates compound against you.

events.title: Mega Festive E-Commerce Sale
events.description: Noise-cancelling headphones you like are at 50% discount (₹7,500 down from ₹15,000). Sale ends in 2 hours!

choices.label: Pass on the sale; add to wishlist for when savings allow
choices.hint: Discounting 50% on something you did not plan is still spending 100%!

choices.label: Raid savings because 'it's too good a deal to miss'
Sign up for a 6-month 'No Cost' EMI card scheme
choices.hint: EMIs eat up future monthly discretionary cash.

games.learning_goal: Teaches how living on a 50/30/20 budget cushions sudden unexpected cash hits.

games.name: Inflation Island
games.tagline: Watch the purchasing power of your hidden cash melt away over decades!
rules: You start in year 2010 with ₹1,00,000 cash under a mattress vs ₹1,00,000 invested in an equity index fund.
Compare what your money can buy: rent, fuel, college fees, groceries.
Experience first-hand why idle cash loses the race against inflation.

timeline.commentary: Both cash and index fund start at equal ₹1,00,000 value.
Cash feels safe, but 6% inflation has eaten 26.5% of its real purchasing power. The index fund grew 82%.
Cash can only buy about half of what it bought in 2010. Index compounding has tripled the investment.
Idle cash was crushed by inflation losing 61.8% of purchasing power. The index fund grew by 5.47x!

games.learning_goal: Proves that keeping cash idle in savings accounts loses real wealth to inflation.
